name: Song of Blood — the creatures that attacked are picked; +1/+0 for each creature card milled, entered by hand
notes: Sweep group 7 (2026-10-07). A spell's delayed trigger "Whenever a creature attacks this turn, it gets …" was not read at all. It is now "Any number of target attacking creatures each get …": the attackers are picked, and the site's picker offers only creatures marked attacking on the board as it is now (Conor's suggestion; perm._pickFromLiveBoard, since they attack after the spell resolved). The number of creature cards milled is typed on the spell's row. Bears and Hill Giant attacked, three creature cards were milled: 5/2 and 6/3. Gray Ogre did not attack.
